postCreateCommand.fish-login-shell: bash -lc 'FISH=$HOME/.nix-profile/bin/fish; grep -qxF "$FISH" /etc/shells || echo "$FISH" | sudo tee -a /etc/shells; sudo chsh -s "$FISH" vscode'
postCreateCommand.fish-nix-config: bash -lc 'mkdir -p $HOME/.config/fish/conf.d; printf "%s\n" "# Nix" "if test -f /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/etc/profile.d/nix-daemon.fish" "    source /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/etc/profile.d/nix-daemon.fish" "end" "if test -f /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/nix.fish" "    source /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/nix.fish" "end" "# End Nix" > $HOME/.config/fish/conf.d/nix.fish'
